status: design frozen for reference implementation review; no heldout labels generated

truth_layers.source_observation: Original cell, source row and provenance. Blank presence is observable; business invalidity is not implied.
truth_layers.declared_policy_reference: Expected result under authored research policy. Program-derived labels are policy references, not independently expert-adjudicated retailer truth.
truth_layers.business_truth: Unavailable for this public dataset; do not report external business accuracy.

reference_generation.implementation: Separate scorer-only module must not import evaluate_retail_policies, contract, runtime model outputs or runtime adapters to compute labels.
reference_generation.development_verification: Handwritten boundary cases and independent methods/implementation review. Shared semantics still means policy compliance, not independent business ground truth.
freeze_order: Freeze reference implementation and tests on development
Generate heldout references without inspecting outcome distributions for tuning
Run arms and score saved outputs only
reference_generation.corrections: A discovered reference bug creates a new version with reason and preserves old labels/scores; report affected denominators. Never silently amend labels to agree with a model.

common_semantics.blank: Absent key, null, or string representation containing only whitespace.
common_semantics.number: Finite base-10 decimal from scalar representation; booleans, missing values and unparseable/nonfinite values produce unknown for numeric policies. No currency-symbol or thousands-separator normalization.
common_semantics.cancellation: Case-insensitive prefix c on invoice string, without trimming nonblank invoice text. Missing invoice makes quantity_sign unknown.
common_semantics.customer_analysis: Blank CustomerID violates the authored requirement. Any nonblank value passes only presence; identifier syntax and actual customer identity are outside this rule.
common_semantics.quantity_sign: C-prefix quantity strictly negative, otherwise strictly positive. Zero violates; fractional magnitude is allowed for this sign-only policy. Integer validation is a different unimplemented policy.
common_semantics.nonnegative_price: Finite price >=0 passes; negative violates; missing/unparseable unknown. Zero is not evidence of a legitimate commercial sale.

construction.input: Identical source definitions, authored policy semantics and permitted development examples; no evaluation references.
construction.output: Versioned interpreted policy artifact and executable implementation or direct-decision prompt.
measure: observed human active time if actually recorded
construction.historical_work: Existing code was created during exploration. Its past construction time is not a prospectively measured baseline.

execution.end_to_end: Run frozen arm-specific interpretation/implementation on common evaluation inputs. Interpretation mistakes remain outcomes.
execution.matched_semantics: Replay identical approved semantics in Python and SHACL separately; label as controlled execution comparison, not LLM construction efficacy.
execution.cost_boundary: Record preprocessing, model request, tool execution, postprocessing separately plus total wall time; report cold/warm setup separately.
execution.repeat_unit: Independent model attempts are repeats, not derived replays. Never retry failed cases silently.

tasks: rename a column with a declared mapping
maintenance.constraint: Do not change heldout policy semantics after seeing its outcomes.

fairness_and_readiness: No arm receives extra policy examples or reviewer corrections for free; record and match intervention budgets or report a human-assisted arm separately.
Runtime source identifiers are matched before scoring; missing/failed outputs preserve the original denominator.
Frozen610rows are not yet labeled or evaluated; only development fixtures have run.
Per-arm model selection, context limits, batch size, tool budget and safe generated-code isolation remain unresolved. No paid launch until separately specified and reviewed.
Same-policy execution may yield identical accuracy; this is a valid outcome, not a failed study.
